scope: Initial P prefill-MC2 startup/profile attempt only

result.note: Occurrence counts are repeated log lines across worker messages, not independent startup attempts.

failure.message_class: HCCL_BUFFSIZE_EP too small; tiling window check failed

source_profile_entry.behavior: When max_num_tokens exceeds MC2 capacity and the selected communication method at that capacity is MC2/FUSED_MC2, profile_run invokes a prefill dummy run at the MC2 capacity before the base profile run.

interpretation_limits: This proves the initial 400 MB buffer was insufficient for the captured MC2 profiling shape.
It does not prove MC2 is generally unsupported at EP64.
It does not prove startup or inference will succeed with a 4096 MB HCCL_BUFFSIZE setting.
It does not establish the memory allocation scope or post-increase KV-cache capacity.
redaction: No IPs, process IDs, raw environment dumps, or full internal paths are included.
